items.title: Settle egress-detection-gap by verifying lane_for_host exists in vet.py
items.why_now: If lane_for_host is missing, MCP egress detection is broken — a critical safety gap that blocks all other work until resolved.

steps.do: Run grep -n 'lane_for_host' daedalus/tools/vet.py and report result
steps.verified_by: grep returns line number(s) or empty output

items.assumption: The full vet.py file is accessible at the given path.

items.title: Settle missing-refresh-todo-snapshot by searching for its definition in memory/__init__.py
items.why_now: append_event calls refresh_todo_snapshot which may be undefined, causing runtime crashes on every event append — this blocks the entire memory subsystem.

steps.do: Search for 'def refresh_todo_snapshot' in daedalus/memory/__init__.py and check imports at top of file
steps.verified_by: grep returns definition line or confirms missing; import inspection reveals if imported from another module

items.assumption: The full file is accessible; if definition is in another file, imports will show it.

items.title: Settle type-node-leak by inspecting build_forest_hierarchy in forest.py for type node filtering
items.why_now: If build_forest_hierarchy does not filter type nodes, reachability analysis may include spurious nodes, corrupting architectural insights. This is a high-severity data integrity issue.

steps.do: Inspect build_forest_hierarchy in forest.py to see if it calls _is_type_node_id or otherwise filters out type nodes from file layers
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection: function body includes filtering logic or not. File path not provided in input; assume forest.py exists in daedalus/mapping/ or similar.

items.assumption: forest.py is part of the daedalus/mapping/ package; file path not given in input, so UNKNOWN.

items.title: Settle ambiguous-stub-resolution by finding a stub-only module and checking caller behavior
items.why_now: If _disambiguate returns a .pyi file as the only source, callers may incorrectly treat it as a runtime module, causing silent failures in test extraction or correctness analysis.

steps.do: Find a module that is only a .pyi file in the repository (e.g., using find . -name '*.pyi' -not -exec test -f {}.py ';' -print)
steps.verified_by: Command returns at least one stub-only module path

steps.do: Check if any caller (e.g., correctness.py test extraction) treats that module as a runtime module by inspecting imports or source analysis
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection: caller references the module without checking for .pyi, or attempts to execute it

items.assumption: Stub-only modules exist in the repository; callers are in correctness.py or similar files; paths not provided in input.
